name: [NEW] Bomb Tag!
desc:
💣 It's Bomb Tag! But wait... you can throw the bomb!?

Race against time to pass off a ticking bomb before it goes BOOM! You'll also unlock super cool abilities that can turn the tide in an instant. Every round is a new chance to strategize and outsmart your opponents. It's time to light the fuse and let the fun begin!

🎮 Bomb Tag is fun with friends and available on all devices!

FREE PRIVATE SERVERS

👍 Be sure to like the game and check out our community and socials for updates, exciting rewards, and new friends to play with!

❤️ We're bringing the game back!
Development has resumed, and we're working to restore, improve, and expand the game with new content and updates.
Thank you to everyone who played, supported, and kept the game alive. This is only the beginning.
